content:
Ravi: deploybot blocked promote for release/2026-06-01 (commit 0f1e2d). Staging canaries failed with manifest visibility race - manifest referenced new layers but some pulls returned old digests. tagging @dana @pm for decision.
deploybot: Promotion aborted at 3133333333. Reason: manifest vs blob visibility race. Job ci/staging/canary#301 reported: layer digest mismatch on pull.

Dana: I think the publish wasn't atomic at the registry edge: manifest uploaded before all layer finalizes propagated. We saw origin having correct digests but some edges returning older blobs.

PM: change window in ~40m. Product prefers avoid rollback. Options: 1) delay 25m to force-edge invalidation and re-verify, 2) pin to last-prod (fast). What's ETA for purge/propagation?

Ops-bot: CDN purge issued at 3133333350 if requested; typical PoP convergence ~10-20m. Mirror rehydrate can be started immediately.

Ravi: propose: purge CDN + run origin-bound canaries (deploybot --no-cdn) to verify origin integrity quickly. If green within 25m, proceed; otherwise pin to sha256:prod-flat. Set cutoff 3133333508.

Dana: agreed. I'll trigger purge and start origin-canaries. Also add a short-term deploybot pre-promote manifest HEAD check to compare layer HEAD digests.

deploybot: Promotion put on hold until 3133333508 per reason 'hold-cdn-purge-origin-verify'. Origin-bypass canaries started.

Ravi: origin-canaries passed (2/2). Running smoke now.

Dana: smoke green. Proceeding with promote to candidate image sha256:0f1e2d after origin verification. Command: `deploybot promote --release release/2026-06-01 --reason "origin-verify-after-manifest-race"`

deploybot: Promotion succeeded. prod now at sha256:0f1e2d. Promotion timestamp: 3133333392.

PM: release note entry: "release/2026-06-01 briefly held due to manifest vs blob visibility race at CDN edge; performed purge and origin-bound canaries; promoted after verification. Follow-up INFR-4600."

Ravi: opened INFR-4600 to track hardening: enforce publish-order atomicity, add pre-promote HEAD/digest checks in deploybot, and add CDN invalidation hook on publish. Dana will own remediation.

Dana: will PR deploybot pre-promote check and coordinate infra changes. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
